request:
Saarbrücken-Lary is a German pathological-voice dataset containing clinically validated voice-disorder labels. Lary means laryngitis (140 healthy, 140 pathological)
All recordings correspond to the sentence \textit{``Guten Morgen, wie geht es Ihnen?'' (``Good morning, how are you?'')} Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: formant_lpc: The user requests anonymization of German pathological voice recordings, skips masking, and asks to compare all methods. Related Saar-HD experience suggests formant_spec and formant_lpc retain pathological cues better than NeuralVC or Resyn. Run formant_lpc, formant_spec, pitch, NeuralVC, and Resyn in sequence and evaluate at the end. run_voice_conversion is independent, but comparing methods requires...
